text:
paula: Quick sync for Tue partner co-hosted webinar (10am PT). Need owners for: partner greenroom access, recording chunking (auto-split per segment), partner clip rights, HubSpot lead scoring based on clip engagement, and post-event partner nurture.

mike: I'll own Zoom + greenroom. Add partners as panelists, alt-hosts set to partner account (partner@acme.com). Note: partners need brief on privacy + recording rights.

jin: I'll handle recording chunking and auto-clip. Plan: auto-split by slide deck markers and speaker changes into 3-6 min segments, plus auto-generate 15s social snippets by speaker. Store under s3://redwood-marketing/partners/2026-04/chunks/. Need naming convention.

olivia: Naming: {event_ts}_{segment_index}_{speaker_short}.mp4 and metadata JSON alongside with utm_campaign, region, language. Also include a clip_rights field owner=partner/redwood.

sara: HubSpot: create lead scoring rule: +10 points if watched_segment>2, +5 for clicked_cta, +20 if partner-demo_request. For partner leads, tag 'partner_ref' and route to partner-success queue. Also capture consent checkbox on reg form: consent_recording.

ops-bot: deploy: recording_rule created -> meeting_id:4012345688, cloud_recording:true, auto_chunk:true, chunk_policy:slide_bounds+speaker_change

mike: Greenroom plan: 9:15 audio check, slide upload, cohost liaison (Olivia), confirm partner-stated clip rights. Also prepare partner release doc and tick box in registration.

jin: Auto-clip pipeline: steps = ingest -> detect markers -> trim -> transcode 720p 30s/60s/15s variants -> tag metadata -> publish to staging. Will generate transcript snippets for each chunk. ETA first batch +2h after event.

olivia: For partner rights: partners can claim clips within 48h. If partner claims, mark clip_rights owner=partner and add to partner folder; otherwise default to redwood distribution. Add claim workflow in the triage sheet.

paula: Post-event cadence: 0h immediate thank-you email + partner CTA, 36h partner-specific highlights email with partner co-branded clip, 5d partner nurture including joint case study invitation. Owner: paula overall, sara handles HubSpot flows, jin handles clips.

sara: Also add phone verification optional field for enterprise regs (two-step SMS) to reduce spam leads. Phone verification result stored in hubspot prop 'phone_verified'.

jin: Ops note: we'll add clip-level analytics: views, rewinds, avg_watch_pct. Push events to Segment as 'clip_viewed' with properties {clip_id, speaker, segment_index, partner_claimed}. Map to HubSpot timeline.

ops-bot: upload: recording 4012345800 uploaded -> s3://redwood-marketing/partners/2026-04/recordings/4012345800.mp4

mike: Final: update partner triage sheet within 6 hours with claimed clips, tags, and routing. I'll send partner release doc to legal for signatures now. If anything blocks ping #marketing-ops and @paula. :handshake:
